title: Spiderwick Meets Dinotopia
content: Tony Diterlizziasked a bunch of his art friends to do drawings set in the Spiderwick cosmos. The drawings will appear in the back of an upcoming omnibus edition of Spiderwick stories.I drew Hogsqueal riding Bix.Here’s a movie of the work in progress, drawn with a Niji water brush filled with Higgins Eternal ink.I gave the original to Tony and he reciprocated with this nifty drawing of Will Denison meeting a befeathered Bix. I love it!Read how he developed his drawing on his blog,link.
